source.check: returned unopposed: two nominations for the two seats; contests only in North and West Wards (Larne Times, 8 May 1952, p. 5, image-read)

note: Municipal elections, 21 May 1952: two councillors for each of the six wards; there was no election for aldermen, who held office until 1955. Sixteen nominations were received for the twelve seats; North Ward was the only contest after withdrawals in West Ward (Larne Times, 8, 22 and 29 May 1952). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed.
